title: Joint red-cell dispersion and size does not clearly improve low-ferritin detection across NHANES samples
abstract: In nonpregnant women aged20–49 with CRP≤5mg/L, NHANES2005–2006 to2007–2008 transfer of an RDW×MCV interaction beyond flexible CBC main effects gave Brier improvement 0.00064160 (95% joint PSU-bootstrap interval -0.00358195 to 0.00481645), without clear incremental evidence; AUC changed -0.00057394.
